claim: The one-click demo builds a bounded, recursively redacted, HMAC-signed envelope with service, error, and first-seen fields.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /; click the sample action and inspect the completed envelope.

claim: The completed sample result is visible in the first 390 by 844 pixel demo viewport.
sandbox: Fresh 390 by 844 browser context at /demo; assert summary, redaction, and signed status intersect the viewport.

claim: Evidence is recursively redacted, limited by item and byte caps, and signed with HMAC-SHA256.
where: How it works, route builder, README
sandbox: Nested private fields and a one-item cap; recompute the HMAC over the unsigned envelope.

claim: The query fingerprint is derived from both the configured source and alert query.
sandbox: Fixed inputs produce a deterministic digest; changing source or query changes it.

claim: The relay fetches evidence only from the configured source and sends only the alert query plus the fixed item limit.
where: How it works, route builder, README
sandbox: Capture the upstream request after an alert supplies a hostile source URL.

claim: The relay preserves an incoming provider signature in the delivered request when one is present.
sandbox: Relay a signed alert to a capture server and inspect both the forwarded header and envelope metadata.

claim: Slack deliveries include the bounded, redacted evidence excerpt and its verifiable HMAC-SHA256 signature.
sandbox: Configure a Slack route to a local capture server; relay two nested-secret rows with a one-item cap; inspect the captured request body and verify its HMAC.

claim: Demo data never enters protected route history and the workspace expires after 24 hours.
where: Landing facts, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: Temporary SQLite; inspect expiry, preview sample data, and protected history.

claim: SQLite does not retain inbound alert bodies or evidence excerpts.
sandbox: Relay unique private markers then inspect closed SQLite bytes.

claim: Delivery history retains only the latest 20 metadata records.
sandbox: Relay 25 distinct alerts, then assert history contains 20 records and drops the oldest five.

claim: Route configuration, preview, history, and inbound relay traffic require server credentials.
sandbox: Send unauthenticated malformed requests to every protected endpoint.

claim: Generated signing, admin, and inbound credentials use protected server files; browser route settings never include them.
sandbox: Temporary paths; assert file modes, supplied overrides, and no token in a configuration response.

claim: A protected preview does not add delivery history.
sandbox: Run an authenticated preview and compare history before and after.

claim: Each delivery route has its own inbound URL, destination, and redaction list.
sandbox: Create two protected routes, relay each, and compare redacted fields and channel IDs.

claim: The normal demo uses no analytics, advertising, third-party scripts, or hosted fonts.
sandbox: Record complete demo request log and assert every request uses the product origin.

claim: The last sample envelope reloads offline after one online demo visit.
sandbox: Dedicated context visits demo, waits for the service worker, then reloads offline.

claim: License tokens stay in browser storage and are sent to Sociobot only in an authorization header; presets stay local.
sandbox: Intercept verification, inspect URL/header, and inspect local storage after saving a preset.

claim: Field Kit saves named redaction presets only in this browser and restores them after reload.
sandbox: Use a cached fixture license, save and apply a named policy, reload, and assert same-origin requests only.

claim: The browser waits 24 hours after each license verification attempt.
sandbox: Recorded failed verification with clock-controlled reloads.

claim: Redaction, signing, preview, export, and route safety controls work without a Field Kit license.
sandbox: Fresh unlicensed demo verifies redaction, signature and copy/export action with no billing call.

claim: The Field Kit page shows a $39 USD one-time price and uses the official Sociobot product checkout URL.
where: Landing facts, Field Kit, terms, README
sandbox: Read price and checkout URL without depending on checkout availability.

claim: An invalid license removes only Field Kit controls and preserves the free relay.
sandbox: Recorded invalid verdict and visible free preview controls.

claim: The cartography was generated for this product on 2026-08-27 and this repository is MIT licensed.
sandbox: Inspect asset prompt metadata, license, font notice and rendered footer.

claim: The container runs as a non-root user with one replica and keeps SQLite state under the mounted /data directory.
sandbox: Inspect the Docker and scoped deployment policy without contacting cloud resources.

claim: API clients receive a 40-request burst, then 20 requests per second, keyed by the first forwarded client IP.
sandbox: Burst 60 requests and inspect 429 Retry-After plus an independent IP.
